title: SWF: ExportAssets tag (tag 56) encoding
description: Test that symbols with exportForActionScript=true produce ExportAssets (tag 56) in the SWF. Verify: (1) tag 56 appears, (2) count field is correct number of exported symbols, (3) each entry has characterId (UI16) + name (null-terminated string), (4) linkageIdentifier appears as the export name, (5) symbols without exportForActionScript do NOT appear in tag 56.
